description.summary: The Draugr is a corporeal undead creature from Norse mythology and Icelandic sagas, distinguished from ghosts by its physical, animated body.
description.full: The Draugr is a corporeal undead creature from Norse mythology and Icelandic sagas, distinguished from ghosts by its physical, animated body. Characterized by superhuman strength, the ability to increase dramatically in size, and a blackish or dark appearance, draugr guard their burial mounds and treasure hoards with jealous, murderous ferocity. These are not mindless zombies—draugr retain their personality and intelligence from life, often displaying the same greed, violence, and malevolence that characterized them as living men. They possess various supernatural powers including shape-shifting, immunity to normal weapons, the ability to drive people mad, and occasionally prophecy. Draugr emit a distinctive smell of decay and death that announces their presence. They can be defeated through beheading, burning the body, or heroic combat by warriors of great strength and courage. The sagas are filled with accounts of heroes battling these formidable undead guardians.
